androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Prime UW when camera becomes active
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Workaround for some Pixel phones with ultrawide autofocus: performs one discarded ultrawide capture when the camera starts to avoid a blurry first photo.

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Save individual wide/ultrawide photos
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: When off, only the two color-matched *_sbs_matched_*.jpg files are written (recommended)

ListPreference.android:title: Video record mode
ListPreference.android:summary: Direct records one finished side-by-side video (waits ~1s for the lenses to settle; Moto dual-device only). Two streams keeps the separate videos and stitches them after

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Stitched SBS video
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: After recording, combine the wide + ultrawide videos into one side-by-side *_sbs.mp4 (the two separate videos are kept too)

ListPreference.android:title: SBS video color match
ListPreference.android:summary: Which lens the other is matched to — live preview and all video modes (GPU, Direct, stitched)

ListPreference.android:title: SBS view
ListPreference.android:summary: Cross-eyed or parallel — which eye goes on the left. Applies to SBS photos, stitched SBS video, and the SBS preview

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Side-by-side preview
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Show both lenses side by side in the live preview, composited on the GPU (cross/parallel follows SBS view). Falls back to the wide lens alone if the phone refuses the second preview stream

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Pair frames (less wiggle swim)
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Wait for a fresh frame from both lenses before drawing the preview, so the two eyes stay in step when the camera moves. Off = draw each lens as its frames arrive, so one eye can lag the other by a frame. If one lens stalls, the preview still draws after a short wait.

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Stereo video JSON log
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Write a JSON log per recording for sync/diagnostics

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Stereo photo JSON log
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Write a tiny JSON log per photo for sync (sensor time + exposure per lens)

androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:title: Photo sync toast
androidx.preference.SwitchPreferenceComp.android:summary: Show a quick Δstart/overlap toast after each photo

Preference.android:title: Dump device/camera info (one-time)
Preference.android:summary: Write a JSON dump (streams, fps ranges, capabilities, etc.) to Documents
